release_notes: Panel polish follow-up to 1.6.0 — update as usual, no extra steps. The Users tab now doubles as your profile: every role manages its own account and two-factor authentication on the Profile sub-tab, admins keep the accounts table on the Users sub-tab (the duplicate profile inside Settings is gone). Fixed the API-keys counter (always showed 0) and widened the keys modal; the timezone picker now covers 246 zones grouped by region with live UTC offsets; System Status reads RAM on hosts that hide /proc and says N/A when that is impossible; the manual Git update command self-provisions Composer.
